points.description: States any one valid advantage of TiC/TiN coating, e.g. excellent wear resistance, thermal stability, low coefficient of friction, improved thermal transfer (heat dissipation), or increased tool life, in any wording.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if vague or only loosely related to a benefit (e.g. 'makes tool better', 'harder') without clearly naming an advantage.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for any one correct advantage from the model answer, in any wording (e.g. lasts longer, resists wear, less friction, withstands heat). Give 1 mark if the answer is vague but on the right track, such as 'harder' or 'better performance'. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the advantage.
